reply.text: {"route": "care", "say": "Let's talk about that before we build anything. Eating one meal every two days is not enough fuel to build muscle, and it can wear down your recovery, your energy and your health. Please talk to a doctor or a registered dietitian about your eating, and tell someone you trust how you have been eating. When you're ready, I'll build you a training plan that fits the food you are actually eating, starting from where you are."}
